headline: A 2016 law renames a VA outpatient clinic in Traverse City, Michigan, after Colonel Demas T. Craw.
what_it_does: This law gives a new name to the Traverse City VA Community-Based Outpatient Clinic in Traverse City, Michigan. The clinic will now be called the Colonel Demas T. Craw VA Clinic. The law does not change the clinic's services, staff, or how veterans use it.
when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was enacted on December 14, 2016.
